title: Cube Unfolding / color / cannot
description: Fold the six exterior faces and compare the printed markings.

difficulty.label: Uncalibrated
difficulty.basis: Track face identities and the cyclic order at a vertex.

question: The net is shown from the printed side. Place that side down before folding upward, so the markings face outward. The left image shows a view of a colored cube. The options are nets that fold upwards to form a cube. Which net, when folded, CANNOT form the cube shown on the left? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

annotation.Question: The left image shows a view of a colored cube. The options are nets that fold upwards to form a cube. Which net, when folded, CANNOT form the cube shown on the left? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

Explanation.ACD: Options ACD are incorrect because they could be valid nets for the given cube. The positions of the Green, Pink, and Yellow faces satisfy the relative positions shown on the cube.
Explanation.B: Option B is correct because this cannot be the net of the given cube. The positions of the Green and Cyan faces are swapped.

answer.explanation: green (column 4, row 2 from the upper left) and yellow (column 2, row 2 from the upper left) are opposite and cannot meet at the visible corner.

options.label: A
options.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from pink (column 1, row 2 from the upper left), then green (column 3, row 3 from the upper left), then yellow (column 2, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.

options.label: B
options.explanation: green (column 4, row 2 from the upper left) and yellow (column 2, row 2 from the upper left) are opposite and cannot meet at the visible corner.

options.label: C
options.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from pink (column 1, row 2 from the upper left), then green (column 2, row 3 from the upper left), then yellow (column 2, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.

options.label: D
options.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from pink (column 1, row 3 from the upper left), then green (column 3, row 2 from the upper left), then yellow (column 2, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.
